tasks.prompt: What status does Querent's ADR index show for ADR-0007 today?
tasks.notes: It is marked superseded only when phase 3 finishes. Violation rule removed when the corpus was assembled: the scorer counts violations only for constraint, negation or limit items, and this item is a fact.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-b
tasks.prompt: Summarise the rules for break-glass access to a Querent tenant's data.

rubric.text: One named engineer gets read access to one tenant for at most 4 hours.

It needs a ticket naming the tenant and reason, security on-call approval, and for Enterprise and Dedicated tenants written consent from the customer's named contact, with no emergency path around consent.
For Team and Business plan tenants (undecided whether to ask), access follows the terms of service, with a notice to the tenant's admin after the session closes.
Write access is not allowed; data fixes go through a reviewed migration script under with_tenant.
Response data must never be copied out of the session into tickets, chat or local files.

tasks.notes: cross-section: Admin tools and support access, Open questions.

tasks.author: ai-task-writer-b

tasks.notes: cross-section: stated in Requirements and in Caching.
